phases.title: Your 8 mood and energy phases
phases.subtitle: Your mood isn't linear — it has phases. Airia automatically detects which phase you're in today and adapts the app to it.

elevated.label: High Flight
elevated.description: Mood and energy above your usual baseline. Great for projects that require creativity and initiative.
elevated.tip: Enjoy the energy, but keep a sustainable pace. Avoid impulsive decisions.

flowing.label: Flowing
flowing.description: You're in your best rhythm. Mental clarity, motivation, and energy aligned.
flowing.tip: Peak productivity. Prioritize your most important tasks now.

stable.label: Stable
stable.description: Balanced baseline state — euthymia. Consistent and predictable rhythm.
stable.tip: Good time to build habits and make steady progress.

falling.label: Slowing Down
falling.description: Downward trend detected. Your mood is below your recent baseline.
falling.tip: Slow down. Prioritize sleep, nutrition, and self-care now.

low.label: Retreat
low.description: You're in a phase of lower mood and energy. It's a natural pattern of your rhythm.
low.tip: This is a time to restore — not to produce. Self-kindness is the priority.

depleted.label: Pause
depleted.description: Very low mood and energy. Your system needs active recovery.
depleted.tip: Cancel what you can. Rest isn't weakness — it's a biological need right now.

recovering.label: Recovery
recovering.description: You're coming out of a low phase. Energy is gradually returning.
recovering.tip: Ease back in. Celebrate every small step — you're on the right track.

mixed.label: Turbulence
mixed.description: High variability detected. Frequent highs and lows with no clear pattern.
mixed.tip: Watch for impulsive decisions. Focus on routine and sleep — they stabilize your rhythm.

insufficient_data.label: Not enough data
insufficient_data.description: Check in for at least 3 days to start tracking your rhythm.
insufficient_data.tip: The more consistent your check-ins, the more accurate your rhythm analysis.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: Welcome to Airia. By using our platform, you agree to the guidelines and responsibilities below, which are designed to support a safe and evolving experience.
terms.s1: Airia is a personal assistant focused on well-being and biological organization. Important: Airia does not replace professional medical, psychiatric, or psychological advice. AI suggestions are based on probability algorithms and must not be used as diagnoses or treatments.
terms.s2: You agree to use Airia ethically and not attempt to bypass security systems, reverse engineer the service, or use the platform for unlawful purposes. Your account is personal and non-transferable.
terms.s3: When using the Google Calendar integration, you acknowledge that Airia acts as a client interacting with your Google account according to the permissions you grant. We are not responsible for accidental event deletions by the original provider or external account settings.
terms.s4: If you use paid features, renewals follow your chosen cycle (monthly or annual). You may cancel at any time and retain access until the end of the paid period.
terms.s5: We may update these terms as we evolve. We will notify you of significant changes. Continued use after changes means you accept the updated terms.
terms.contact: For legal support or questions: legal@airia.pro

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy is foundational to Airia. Because you entrust us with your biological and emotional journey, we are committed to protecting every piece of data with rigorous technical and ethical safeguards.
privacy.s1: Airia collects information you voluntarily provide while using the app, such as mood records, energy levels, sleep patterns, and personal goals. This data is processed only to provide personalized insights and help you harmonize your routine.
privacy.s2: If you enable Google Calendar sync, Airia requests access to view your events and create new commitments in your calendar.
privacy.access: What we access: titles, times, and durations of existing events to avoid planning conflicts.
privacy.create: What we create: only the time blocks you explicitly confirm in Airia's Planner.
privacy.policy: Our policy: we do not share your calendar data with third parties or use it for advertising.
privacy.s3: We use modern infrastructure, including Supabase for authentication and PostgreSQL for storage, with Row-Level Security (RLS) policies. Your data is isolated and inaccessible to anyone else, including our team, unless strictly necessary for technical support you request.
privacy.s4: Your journal reflections and interactions with Airia AI are processed to generate summaries and life insights. We use AI models through secure APIs, where your data is not used for public training of third-party models.
privacy.s5: You retain full ownership of your data. At any time, you may request complete deletion of your account and its associated history through the app settings.
privacy.contact: For questions or requests, contact support@airia.pro

aboutApp.label: About the app
aboutApp.description: How Airia's AI works, what it calculates, and why it suggests each next step.
aboutApp.aiDescription: Airia combines generative AI with a proprietary mood-and-energy phase engine. It does not answer from scratch: it cross-checks check-ins, journal, planner, goals, habits, history, and recent memories to understand the real context of the day.
aboutApp.purposeDescription: Its role is to be an emotional and operational copilot for non-linear minds. It separates fact from interpretation, recognizes patterns, points to pending decisions, and turns the current state into one possible next step.
aboutApp.phaseDescription: Your phase comes from recent mood and energy averages, multi-day trend, variation/stability, sleep, and time in phase. With little data, the reading stays conservative.
aboutApp.chartDescription: Week and Today use real check-ins. Monthly uses the last 30 days. The solid line is mood, the dashed line is energy. Face emojis show mood intensity and the emojis below dates show the phase calculated for that point.
aboutApp.forecastDescription: The forecast projects mood and energy from recent history, smoothing spikes so one isolated day does not become a trend. It changes as new check-ins come in.
aboutApp.autonomyDescription: The score starts at 100 and loses points for high variation, abrupt trend, low days, sparse check-ins, and critical signals. The current phase calibrates whether the suggestion should advance, contain, simplify, or recover.
aboutApp.alertsDescription: Alerts only appear with evidence: overdue commitment, stalled goal, rapid drop, low stability, many low days, impulse mentioned to the AI, or sleep with strong impact.
aboutApp.patternsDescription: Patterns come from repetition in history: best/worst days, mood distribution, check-in streak, phase transitions, and the relationship between sleep, energy, social load, and mood.
aboutApp.patternCardsDescription: The 7, 30, 90-day, half-year and yearly filters slice the history. Best day and difficult day come from average mood by weekday. Distribution separates high, stable and low records. Streak counts consecutive check-in days without a break.
aboutApp.harmonyDescription: The radar compares six dimensions on the same scale: mood, energy, goals, social, body and sleep. Each axis uses the selected period average; goals use active-goal progress. Overall balance is the average of axes with data.
aboutApp.weeklyCompareDescription: The comparison calculates current-week and previous-week averages for mood, energy and number of check-ins. The arrow shows rise, drop or stability against the previous period.
aboutApp.checkinDescription: Each check-in records mood, energy, sleep, body, social load, emotion, and a free note. Recent check-ins weigh more in the daily reading.
aboutApp.contextDescription: Planner, goals, habits, journal, and recent suggestions enter the context. Airia uses this to avoid repetition and suggest steps that fit the current state.
